description: Natural Hazards Research Summit 2022:A Decision-Support Tool for Testing Land Use Policies in the Context of Natural Hazard Risk is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Rachel Davidson, University of Delaware (udel.edu). The continued demand for the construction of new houses in high-risk areas is a significant driver of society’s increasing natural hazard risk. One method for altering housing development patterns and minimizing a housing inventory’s natural hazard risk is to leverage land use policies. Coverage: Washington, DC. DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-9kfb-3393. Keywords: housing, building inventory, land use planning, hurricane. Published 2023-03-12. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
